issue_reported: Engine shows DEGRADED status and health check returns red error when image not pulled yet

root_causes.flaw: $engine->status = $isAvailable ? 'AVAILABLE' : 'DEGRADED'; immediately marks missing image as DEGRADED instead of STANDBY or triggering auto-pull
root_causes.http_response: Returns 'message' => 'Image {$image} belum di-pull di docker daemon.' without action trigger

root_causes.flaw: actionMessage.value = { type: res.data.image_present ? 'success' : 'danger' }; flashes red alert box on missing image, alarming users without offering a pull action button
Newly registered engines (codeql, sonarqube, trufflehog, dependency_check, kubescape, wapiti, wuppiefuzz) were degraded during initial healthchecks prior to image downloads completing
